fixes.explanation: Whoa, careful, friend, that one flips it! Paul says the opposite: “Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.” (Galatians 5:8). He had just told them they were running well, so something cut into their lane, and he wants them to know where it didn't come from. Check the source before you swerve, friend!

False, and Paul wastes no time. “Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.” (Galatians 5:8). Right before this he asks who got in the way of their running, and now he tells them where that pull did not come from. So when a voice tugs you off course, ask where it came from. Good catch, baker!

Whoa, flip that one over, friend. Paul says the opposite: “The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.” (Galatians 5:10). He has just said he's confident in the Lord that they will take no other view, so I think he's steady here, not shaky. This is a heavy line, so I'll leave it right there.
